# 00000000230

**English.** Definition: The Somos-4 sequence is an integer sequence generated by a quadratic recurrence. Conjecture: The sequence consists of integers and is the tau function of a cluster algebra; and the tau property is settled through star-triangle reflections. (Somos-4 cluster tau integrality)

**中文。** 定义：Somos-4 序列为二次递推整序列。猜想：序列为整数且为簇代数的 tau 函数；且 tau 的核为星形折返。（Somos-4 星形折返簇 tau 整性）
